comment: The manual describes a Chronos context menu for choosing which polyphonic channel each section's light shows. The installed build has no such menu: chronos.cpp overrides no appendContextMenu, and the "LEDs channel" item appears only for Fortuna. The ledsChannel value exists in the Chronos code and stays at channel 1. The wave outputs have no single voltage range: they span 0V to 10V with bipolar mode off and ±5V with it on, so no range is recorded for them.
